questions.q: Lost sale costs 4 and a wasted unit costs 1. At what quantile (decimal) should you order?
Demand at your service level is 41 contacts per half hour, one agent handles 10. How many agents?

options: Rounding down breaks the SLA because the demand would exceed capacity
why: Rounding down is cheaper but breaks the promise.

questions.q: Scenario: you add the p90 forecasts of 8 independent SKUs to size a warehouse. The result will usually be:
options: Larger than the p90 of the total demand

questions.q: Which input tells you that sales understate demand?
Scenario: lead time is 3 weeks and orders are placed weekly. Which demand should you forecast per SKU?
options: Demand over the next 4 weeks (lead time + review period)

questions.q: What should you check before trusting a 0.75 quantile forecast for ordering?
options: Its calibration: does demand stay below it about 75% of the time?

questions.q: What is the best way to let the business choose a service level?
options: Show the curve of cost (stock or agents) against service level and agree a point
